# U.S. Geological Survey

> The USGS provides scientific research and monitoring across natural hazards, water resources, ecosystems, climate change, geospatial mapping, and mineral resources to support evidence-based decision-making.

The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) is a scientific agency of the U.S. Department of the Interior that conducts research and monitoring across multiple domains including earthquake and volcano monitoring, water availability assessment, climate adaptation, coastal hazards, and geospatial data infrastructure. The organization operates through mission areas and regional centers to deliver science that informs policy and public safety.

## Key Topics

- Natural Hazards
- Water Resources
- Climate Change
- Geospatial Mapping
- Critical Minerals
- Ecosystems
- Remote Sensing
- Landsat
- 3DEP
- National Map
- ShakeAlert
- Coastal Hazards
- Volcano Monitoring
- Earth Science
- Regional Science Centers

## Mission Areas

- [Mission Areas](https://www.usgs.gov/science/mission-areas): Overview of USGS major research mission areas and science priorities
- [Natural Hazards Mission Area](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/natural-hazards): Natural Hazards mission monitoring earthquakes, volcanoes and coastal hazards
- [Water Resources Mission Area](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/water-resources): Water Resources mission covering monitoring, quality and availability assessment
- [Ecosystems Mission Area](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/ecosystems): Ecosystems mission area covering wildfire, drought, conservation and food-water security
- [Geology, Energy, and Minerals Mission Area](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/geology-energy-minerals): Geology, Energy and Minerals mission with critical minerals and resource assessment
- [Core Science Systems Mission Area](https://www.usgs.gov/mission-areas/core-science-systems): Core Science Systems mission covering geospatial mapping and National Map products

## Science Topics & Explorer

- [Science Explorer](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer): Topical directory to browse USGS science programs, data, news and multimedia content
- [Natural Hazards](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/natural-hazards): Natural hazards monitoring including earthquakes, floods, volcanoes and ShakeAlert system
- [Climate](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/climate): Climate change research, impacts and adaptation strategies with National Climate Change Viewer
- [Maps and Mapping](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/maps-and-mapping): USGS mapping products including National Map, 3DEP and geospatial data services
- [Coasts](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/coasts): Coastal science covering ecosystems, hazards, sea-level rise and marine resource management
- [Minerals](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/minerals): Mineral resource assessment, critical minerals and supply chain management
- [Biology](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/biology): USGS biological science expertise in conservation, species management and ecosystem health
- [Ocean](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/ocean): Ocean science covering marine ecosystems, seafloor mapping and deep-sea exploration

## Programs & Organization

- [Programs](https://www.usgs.gov/science/programs): Directory of USGS science programs, geospatial mapping and earth monitoring initiatives
- [Regions](https://www.usgs.gov/science/regions): USGS regional science centers and geographic research organization

## Regional Centers

- [Northeast Region](https://www.usgs.gov/regions/northeast-region): Northeast Region science centers covering geology, ecology and water resources
- [Southeast Region](https://www.usgs.gov/regions/southeast): Southeast Region research in water resources, coral and environmental monitoring

## Planetary Science

- [Planetary Science](https://www.usgs.gov/science/science-explorer/planetary-science): USGS planetary science research with NASA including Mars 2020 and Artemis missions

## Home

- [USGS.gov Homepage](https://www.usgs.gov): USGS homepage covering natural hazards, resources, ecosystems, climate and land-use impacts
